method: For each placement: the proposal's start height (its DAO DAO proposal module). LEAD = the 14 days before it opened, BASE = the 28 days before that. Per bribed pool, from every swap and liquidity add / withdrawal on chain (archive node): volume per day lead vs base, distinct traders and top-3 share in the lead window, liquidity added / withdrawn in the lead window and the largest adder's share. Repeat wallets: among the 5 largest lead-window traders or liquidity adders of an EARLIER placement's picks. Aggregates only — individual wallets are counted, never named; organisations (catalog entities) are named.
